item.title: Hundreds of protestors call for ICE abolition
item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) – Hundreds gathered in front of Congressman Mike Turner’s office this weekend, protesting federal immigration enforcement policies and calling for the abolition of ICE. Organizers said the protest was meant to voice opposition to ICE, along with their concern that ICE agents could be on their way to Springfield come next week. [...]
